observable_description: TGF-β1 concentration in human PDAC patient serum/plasma (ng/mL or nM) bridged to V_T.TGFb via a serum:tumor auxiliary parameter
notes: BUCKET (relaxed via auxiliary parameter): human PDAC patients, treatment-naive at sample collection, absolute serum/plasma TGF-β1 concentration. Compartment mismatch (serum vs V_T) is bridged by an auxiliary parameter f_serum_to_tumor_TGFb (group: serum_to_tumor; declared in observable.auxiliary_parameters; sampled jointly during inference). Acceptable sources: human PDAC serum/plasma ELISA studies (treatment-naive cohorts); tumor tissue lysate/interstitial fluid still preferred when available (in that case omit the auxiliary parameter and bind V_T.TGFb directly). REJECT: mouse models (KPC/PDX/subQ allograft); in-vitro cell-line conditioned media; LPS- or cytokine-stimulated cell systems; post-neoadjuvant/post-chemo/post-radiation cohorts (unless treatment-naive subset reported separately); IHC scores; relative RNA expression. REQUIRED: absolute concentration in pg/mL, ng/mL, or pg/mg protein with sample size; specify whether total or active TGF-β; if total, observable.code should divide by the bioactive fraction (~10) before applying the auxiliary factor. AUXILIARY USE: declare ``f_serum_to_tumor_TGFb`` (group=serum_to_tumor, units=dimensionless) in observable.auxiliary_parameters and use it in observable.code: predicted serum = V_T.TGFb * (active_fraction) / f_serum_to_tumor_TGFb (or equivalent — pick the convention that keeps f close to 1 = same compartment). ORIGINAL NOTES: TGF-β1 bioactive concentration. Constrains V_T.TGFb. Critical: model species is BIOACTIVE pool (already scaled by f_active_TGFb at production); if source measures total TGFb, divide by ~10 (typical bioactive fraction) — flag in YAML rationale. Saturation context: H_TGFb_APC, H_TGFb_CAF_act, H_TGFb_Teff, H_TGFb_col_sec all saturate at posterior median V_T.TGFb=0.41 nM. Translation sigma: ELISA total vs bioactive-equivalent → moderate (σ~0.3 in log space; the auxiliary group's tau_g already absorbs cross-cytokine deviation). Acceptance: posterior contraction on V_T.TGFb at the diagnosis snapshot. Suggested search terms: "pancreatic cancer serum TGF-beta1 ELISA", "PDAC plasma transforming growth factor beta concentration", "untreated pancreatic adenocarcinoma circulating TGF-beta1 pg/mL".

observable_description: IL-12 (p70) concentration in human PDAC patient serum/plasma (pg/mL or pM) bridged to V_T.IL12 via a serum:tumor auxiliary parameter
notes: BUCKET (relaxed via auxiliary parameter): human PDAC patients, treatment-naive, absolute serum/plasma IL-12p70 concentration. Compartment mismatch is bridged by f_serum_to_tumor_IL12 (group: serum_to_tumor). REJECT: mouse models; LPS-/cytokine-stimulated cell-line conditioned media (these inform k_IL12_sec, already covered via Silveira2025 submodel target); IHC; RNA. REQUIRED: absolute pg/mL or pM in human PDAC serum/plasma; sample size + treatment-naive status. CENSORED LIKELIHOOD (Pattern B): human serum IL-12p70 frequently sits at or below the assay LOD in PDAC patients; observable.code MUST detect when median < LOD and switch to a censored likelihood (return LOD as the observable AND mark the data as upper-bounded — encode by adjusting the empirical_data CI95 lower edge to 0 and median to LOD/2 with a wide CI95, OR by including an LOD constant in observable.constants and in the YAML's distribution_code so the derived ci95_lower reflects the censoring). Document the convention chosen in mapping_rationale. AUXILIARY USE: declare ``f_serum_to_tumor_IL12`` (group=serum_to_tumor, units=dimensionless) and use in observable.code. ORIGINAL NOTES: Posterior median V_T.IL12=3 pM (≈0.2 pg/mL); H_IL12=0.19 (mid-low band, functional). Cold-tumor PDAC has characteristically very low IL-12, which is exactly why the censored-LOD path is mandatory. Suggested search terms: "pancreatic cancer serum IL-12p70 ELISA", "PDAC plasma interleukin-12 pg/mL multiplex", "human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cytokine panel serum IL-12".

observable_description: Arginase-I concentration in human PDAC patient serum/plasma (ng/mL or U/mL) bridged to V_T.ArgI via a serum:tumor auxiliary parameter
notes: BUCKET (relaxed via auxiliary parameter): human PDAC patients, treatment-naive, absolute serum/plasma arginase-I concentration or activity (with conversion to enzyme concentration via specific activity ~70 U/mg). Compartment mismatch is bridged by f_serum_to_tumor_ArgI (group: serum_to_tumor). REJECT: mouse models; in-vitro stimulated cell systems; IHC scores; scRNA/RNA-ISH; MDSC-frequency-only papers without absolute Arg1 concentration. REQUIRED: human PDAC serum/plasma absolute Arg1 concentration (ng/mL) or activity (U/mL converted to nM via 70 U/mg specific activity); sample size; treatment-naive status. AUXILIARY USE: declare ``f_serum_to_tumor_ArgI`` (group=serum_to_tumor, units=dimensionless) in observable.auxiliary_parameters and apply in observable.code. ORIGINAL NOTES: Posterior median V_T.ArgI=1.74 nM (≈70 ng/mL); H_ArgI_Teff=0.82 saturating in 11% of sims. MW ~40 kDa for Arg-I monomer. Suggested search terms: "pancreatic cancer serum arginase-I ELISA", "PDAC plasma ARG1 ng/mL", "human pancreatic adenocarcinoma serum arginase activity U/mL".
